build_template_btn.what: Builds a simple MetaHuman rig from the template picked in the list.
examples: Pick a template and click it to get a ready face rig to test.
Build a template to see how the MetaHuman rig works.

load_dna_builder_button.what: Opens a file browser and puts the chosen MetaHuman .dna file in the field.
examples: Pick the .dna exported from MetaHuman Creator.
Pick a .dna from Quixel Bridge.

build_dna_button.tip: Build a MetaHuman from the .dna file.
build_dna_button.what: Builds the MetaHuman rig described by the .dna file in the field.
examples: Load your character .dna and click Build.
Build the client MetaHuman from their .dna.
build_dna_button.details: create_simple_metahuman(dna_path=field): the DNA holds joints, blendshapes and the rig logic.

export_face_sel.tip: Export the selected head to wrap.
export_face_sel.what: Exports the selected head geometry so you can wrap the MetaHuman topology onto it in Wrap.
steps: Wrap the MetaHuman head onto it in Wrap.
examples: Select your character head, click it, then Open Wrap.
Export a sculpted creature head to wrap.
export_face_sel.details: export_geo_for_wrap(mode="Face"): obj into the project data folder, versioned.

open_wrap_btn.what: Starts the Wrap application to fit the MetaHuman head to your model.
examples: Click it after exporting the head.
Open Wrap to fit the MetaHuman head to a scan.
open_wrap_btn.details: Runs r3ds_wrap (or "sclenv r3ds_wrap" on studio Linux).

open_meta_mutant_btn.what: Opens the folder with the exported and wrapped geometry.
examples: Find the wrapped head Wrap saved.
Find the exported obj to drag into Wrap.

wrapped_head_btn.what: Opens a file browser and puts the wrapped head alembic in the field.
examples: Pick the .abc you exported from Wrap.
Pick the abc saved from Wrap.

import_wrapped_head_btn.what: Imports the wrapped head alembic from the field into the scene.
examples: Click it, then fill the pivot fields below.
Import it to check the wrap before building.

l_eye_pivot_btn.tip: Use the selected object as the left eye pivot.
l_eye_pivot_btn.what: Select the left eye pivot in the scene and click <<: its name goes in the field next to the button.
examples: Select the left eyeball and click <<.
A locator works too: place it where the l eye pivot btn pivot should be and pick it.
l_eye_pivot_btn.details: selection_to_line_edit(): writes the cleaned selection in the field; asks before replacing a filled field. Save the fields with S to reuse them.

create_position_locators_btn.tip: Create locators at the picked positions.
create_position_locators_btn.what: Makes a locator at each position filled above so you can check and adjust them.
examples: Click it and move the jaw locator if the hinge is off.
Check the tongue locators sit inside the mouth.
create_position_locators_btn.details: create_position_locators(fields): one locator per filled field, to check before building.

save_btn.what: Saves every field above to a json file.
examples: Save them to rebuild the same character later.
Save the pivots of a character to rebuild after model changes.
save_btn.details: Writes every pivot / teeth / tongue / jaw field to a json you pick.

load_btn.what: Loads a json saved with S and fills the fields.
examples: Load last session settings and click Build Custom Meta Human.
Load the pivots for a new version of the head.
load_btn.details: Reads that json back into the fields.

build_custom_btn.tip: Build the MetaHuman on your head.
build_custom_btn.what: Builds a MetaHuman rig fitted to the wrapped head, using the positions above.
steps: Fill every position field (S to save them).
examples: Fill every field, click it and wait.
Build a MetaHuman face on a stylized character head.
Rebuild after moving the jaw pivot.
build_custom_btn.details: create_custom_metahuman(new_geo, custom_data, custom_data_positions): fits the MetaHuman joints to the wrapped head and the picked pivots, then saves the settings.

save_temp_btn.tip: Save the scene as a temp file.
save_temp_btn.what: Saves the current scene to a temp MetaMutant file.
examples: Save before a long step so you can go back.
Save before extracting shapes in case it crashes.
save_temp_btn.details: Renames the scene to %TEMP%/MetaMutant/MetaMutant_Build.ma and saves it: the scene name changes, save to your own path after.

load_temp_btn.what: Imports the temp MetaMutant file saved before.
examples: Bring back the build you saved as temp.
Import the temp build into a clean scene.

trasnfer_to_sel_btn.tip: Transfer the MetaHuman skin to the selected head.
trasnfer_to_sel_btn.what: Skins the selected head to the MetaHuman joints and copies the weights from the MetaHuman head.
examples: Select your head mesh and click it.
Skin a stylized head with MetaHuman weights.
trasnfer_to_sel_btn.details: Skins the selected mesh to every joint under spine_04, then copySkinWeights from head_lod0_mesh.

skin_r_eye_btn.tip: Skin the selection to the right eye joint.
skin_r_eye_btn.what: Skins the selected geo fully to the MetaHuman right eye joint.
examples: Select the right eyeball geo and click it.
Skin the right cornea geo too.

skin_l_eye_btn.tip: Skin the selection to the left eye joint.
skin_l_eye_btn.what: Skins the selected geo fully to the MetaHuman left eye joint.
examples: Select the left eyeball geo and click it.
Skin the left cornea geo too.

skin_upper_teeth_btn.tip: Skin the selection to the upper teeth joint.

examples: Select the upper teeth and gums and click it.
Skin the upper gums.

skin_lower_teeth_btn.tip: Skin the selection to the lower teeth joint.

examples: Select the lower teeth and click it.

skin_tongue_btn.tip: Skin the selection to the tongue joints.

examples: Select the tongue geo and click it.
Skin a stylized tongue.
skin_tongue_btn.details: Skins to FACIAL_C_Tongue1-4, TongueUpper2-3, TongueLower3 and L / R TongueSide2-3.

animate_btn.what: Keys the MetaHuman face through its poses so the shapes can be extracted.
examples: Click it, then Extract Shapes.
Animate, then scrub to check every expression.
animate_btn.details: meta_mutant.animate(): keys the face rig through every expression, one per frame.

extract_shapes_btn.what: Makes one shape per pose from the main face geo.
examples: Click it after Animate.
Extract shapes to use outside the MetaHuman rig.
extract_shapes_btn.details: extract_shapes(main_geo): duplicates the main geo at each keyed pose into one shape per expression.

save_as_temp_btn.tip: Save the extracted shapes as temp.
save_as_temp_btn.what: Saves the extracted shapes to a temp file.
examples: Save them before splitting.
Save the shapes before splitting.

load_as_temp_btn.what: Loads the shapes saved with Save as Temp.
examples: Bring the shapes back in a new scene.
Load the shapes into the Mutant face scene.

split_shapes_btn.what: Opens the shapes in the SHAPES tool to split them into left / right.
examples: Click it and split the smile shape.
Split a wide smile into left and right.
split_shapes_btn.details: open_shapes(): opens the SHAPES plugin UI.

connect_shapes_btn.tip: Connect the shapes to the Mutant face.
connect_shapes_btn.what: Connects the shapes to the Mutant face rig ctrls.
examples: Last step: click it and test the face ctrls.
Connect, then test the smile ctrl.
connect_shapes_btn.details: connect_shapes_to_mutant_face(): blendShape on the Mutant face with each shape driven by its face ctrl.
